description: 石岡壩集水區範圍圖 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部水利署. 石岡壩水庫集水區範圍位於台中市石岡區大甲溪最下游，所攔引大甲溪水源，供作家用及公共給水、農業用水、工業用水等用水標的使用。 本水庫集水區範圍係以石岡壩大壩以上全流域稜線以內所涵蓋之區域為原則劃設而成，集水區面積約186. 45平方公里。 經濟部水利署中區水資源局於102年2月28日依據「水庫集水區圖資製作與查認作業要點」規定，提送石岡壩水... Coverage: Shigang Dam. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部水利署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, xml. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
